name: system.agent.activate
description:
Activate a core or custom agent, persisting the enabled state.
Parameters: id (required).

name: system.agent.create
description: Create a new custom agent with personality, model, tools, and configuration.

name: system.agent.deactivate
description:
Deactivate an agent (makes it unavailable for new sessions), persisting the disabled state.
Parameters: id (required).

name: system.agent.delete
description:
Delete an agent and all its data (sessions, memory, workspace).
Parameters: id (required), confirm (bool, must be true).

name: system.agent.list
description:
List all agents with their status, model, and task count.
Parameters: status (optional: active/inactive/all, default all).

name: system.agent.read_metadata
description: Read one of the calling agent's metadata files (SOUL.md, HEARTBEAT.md, MEMORY.md, or AGENT.md). Pass agent_id to read another agent's metadata (subject to per-agent policy).

name: system.agent.update
description: Update an existing agent's configuration. Only provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left as-is.

name: system.agent.write_metadata
description: Write one of the calling agent's metadata files (SOUL.md, HEARTBEAT.md, MEMORY.md, or AGENT.md) atomically. AGENT.md content is validated for well-formed frontmatter before writing. Pass agent_id to write another agent's metadata (subject to per-agent policy).

name: system.channel.configure
description:
Configure an enabled channel with its credentials (token, phone_number, etc).
Parameters: id (required), plus channel-specific credentials.

name: system.channel.disable
description:
Disable a channel connection. The channel will stop on the next config reload.
Parameters: id (required, the channel type e.g. 'telegram', 'discord').

name: system.channel.enable
description:
Enable a channel connection. The channel will start on the next config reload.
Parameters: id (required, the channel type e.g. 'telegram', 'discord').

name: system.channel.list
description: List all channels with status and implementation tier. No parameters required.

name: system.channel.test
description:
Test a channel's configuration — checks the channel exists, is enabled, and has credentials configured.
Parameters: id (required, the channel type e.g. 'telegram', 'discord').

name: system.config.get
description:
Read a configuration value by dot-notation key.
Parameters: key (required, e.g. 'gateway.port').

name: system.config.set
description:
Update a configuration value.
Parameters: key (required), value (required).

name: system.cost.query
description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Querying LLM cost data by period/agent is not yet built. The only cost data Omnipus persists today is a single running total for the current UTC day (no historical periods, per-agent breakdown, or grouping). This tool always returns a NOT_IMPLEMENTED error.

name: system.doctor.run
description: Run security diagnostics and return a risk score (0-100) with actionable recommendations. No parameters required.

name: system.mcp.add
description:
Add an MCP server to the configuration (tools.mcp.servers). The server is persisted to config.json and connects on next reload.
Parameters: name (required), transport (stdio/sse/http; default stdio), command (required for stdio), url (required for sse/http), args, env.

name: system.mcp.list
description: List all MCP servers configured in tools.mcp.servers with their transport and enabled state. No parameters required.

name: system.mcp.remove
description:
Remove an MCP server from the configuration (tools.mcp.servers) and persist the change.
Parameters: name (required), confirm (bool, must be true).

name: system.models.list
description: List available models from configured providers. Optional: filter by provider name. Returns model slugs, provider, and whether it's the system default.

name: system.navigate
description:
Navigate the UI to a specific screen.
Parameters: screen (chat/command-center/agents/skills/settings), agent_id (optional), section (optional).

name: system.pin.create
description:
Pin a chat response.
Parameters: session_id (required), message_id (required), title, tags, workspace_id.

name: system.pin.delete
description: Delete a pin. Parameters: id (required), confirm (bool, must be true).

name: system.pin.list
description:
List pinned artifacts with optional filters.
Parameters: agent_id, workspace_id, tags, search (all optional).

name: system.provider.configure
description:
Add or update an LLM provider with its API key.
Parameters: name (required), api_key (for cloud), api_base (optional).

name: system.provider.list
description: List configured providers with connection status. API keys are never returned. No parameters required.

name: system.provider.test
description: Test a provider connection. Parameters: name (required).

name: system.skill.create
description: Author a NEW skill (procedural memory). Writes a SKILL.md to the user skills directory; the write is consent-gated and versioned. Parameters: name (required, alphanumeric+hyphens), content (required, full SKILL.md including YAML frontmatter with name and description).

name: system.skill.edit
description: Edit / refine an EXISTING skill (self-improvement). Snapshots the prior version for rollback, then writes the new SKILL.md. Editing a built-in creates a user override; the built-in is never mutated in place. The write is consent-gated and versioned. Parameters: name (required), content (required, full new SKILL.md).

name: system.skill.install
description:
Install a skill from ClawHub.
Parameters: name (required), agent_ids (optional), credentials (optional).

name: system.skill.list
description: List all installed skills. No parameters required.

name: system.skill.remove
description: Remove an installed skill. Parameters: name (required), confirm (bool, must be true).

name: system.skill.search
description:
Search ClawHub for skills.
Parameters: query (required), sort (trending/new/popular), limit.

name: system.task.create
description:
Create a task on the workspace board. Call this when the user wants to create, add, or track a task or action item. If the user mentioned a workspace name, call system.workspace.list first to get the workspace_id.
Parameters: name (required, the task title), description (optional), prompt (optional, agent instruction), workspace_id (required, from system.workspace.list), agent_id (optional, agent to assign), status (optional: inbox=new/untriaged, next=ready, planning, in_progress, blocked, done, failed — defaults to inbox), due (optional, RFC 3339 due date/time), blocked_by (optional, array of task IDs this task is blocked by).

name: system.task.delete
description: Delete a task. Parameters: id (required), confirm (bool, must be true).

name: system.task.list
description:
List tasks with optional filters.
Parameters: workspace_id, agent_id, status (all optional).

name: system.task.update
description:
Update an existing task. Call this to change status, reassign, rename, or link to a workspace. Use system.task.list first to find the task id.
Parameters: id (required, from system.task.list), name, description, prompt, workspace_id, agent_id, status (inbox/next/planning/in_progress/blocked/done/failed), due (RFC 3339), blocked_by (array of task IDs, replaces existing list). Only provided fields are updated.

name: system.workspace.create
description:
Create a new workspace to group related tasks. Call this when the user mentions starting a new workspace, initiative, or area of work. Returns the created workspace's id — pass this id to system.task.create when creating tasks for the workspace.
Parameters: name (required, workspace title), description (optional, free text), core_team (optional, list of agent IDs associated with this workspace), repository (optional, git URL).

name: system.workspace.delete
description:
Delete a workspace and all its tasks. This is irreversible — all GTD tasks belonging to the workspace are permanently deleted. Call system.workspace.list first to find the workspace id. Requires confirm:true.
Parameters: id (required), confirm (bool, must be true to prevent accidental deletion).

name: system.workspace.get
description:
Get a single workspace by ID including its live task count. Use this to refresh workspace data after creating tasks.
Parameters: id (required, from system.workspace.list).

name: system.workspace.list
description:
List all active workspaces with their task counts. Call this to find workspace ids before calling system.task.create, system.task.list, or system.workspace.update. Returns newest workspaces first.
Parameters: status (optional: active/archived/all, defaults to active).

name: system.workspace.update
description:
Update an existing workspace's name, description, status, pin state, core team, or repository. Call this when the user wants to rename, archive, pin, or reconfigure a workspace. Use system.workspace.list first to find the workspace id.
Parameters: id (required, from system.workspace.list), name, description, status (active/archived), pinned (bool), pin_order (int), core_team (list of agent IDs), repository (git URL). Only provided fields are updated.
